title: Chile climate-policy document inventory (compiled)
description: The inventory layer of Chile's climate-policy document universe: one row per policy/planning instrument, indexed by its position in the LMCC policy stack (rollup) and the facet axes a coverage view needs (level, document type, strand, sector, region, status). Chile is the 'inheritance' case — a unitary state whose framework law (Ley 21.455 / LMCC) mandates a nested cascade ECLP -> sectoral plans -> regional PARCC -> communal PACCC — so applicability is a clean scale rule (contrast the Brazil compile's 'enumeration' case). Compiled fresh from public government sources to test the dataset-compile method against the cl-climate-policy.md context map, independent of the cl-ssg review data. Staging lane: not yet vetted through dataset-review. See collection.md for provenance and sources.yaml for the source registry.
grain: one row per climate-policy or climate-relevant planning instrument (document)

scope.in_scope: National tier fully enumerated (NDC 2025, LMCC framework law, ECLP long-term strategy). Sectoral plans: 7 mitigation (LMCC Art. 8 ministries) + 11 adaptation sectors (9 legacy PANCC priority sectors + Mineria + Zonas Costeras per ECLP). PARCC: all 16 regions, each with its approval status. PACCC: a sample of the confirmable communal plans (~22 of 345 exist) plus two region-level coverage rows (Los Rios 12/12, Nuble 6). Territorial-planning instrument classes (PNOT, PROT, PRI/PRM, PRC) and the 3 PRAS environmental programmes (Huasco, Quintero-Puchuncavi, Coronel).
scope.not_yet_in_scope: The full 345-commune PACCC enumeration (only the confirmable ones are rowed; two regions captured as aggregate rows). Per-region PROT/PRC document instances (only the instrument classes are rowed, mirroring Chile's placeholder reality). Instrument full text / signal extraction (downstream). Exact commune INE codes in territory_code for communal rows (commune segment left as 000 pending a commune-code lookup).
scope.complete_when: Every national + sectoral instrument present with a fetched source_url; all 16 PARCCs tracked to their current approval resolution; the PACCC sample resolved to one row per commune with its own source; territorial instrument classes resolved to per-territory instances where in scope; region_code/territory_code computed by rule for every row; and derived fields (strand, stack_tier) promoted to documented rules.

field_provenance_legend.sourced: read directly from a primary source (verifiable against source_url)
field_provenance_legend.derived: assigned by the compiler's judgment, NOT stated in the source — lower-trust until a deterministic rule is defined
field_provenance_legend.derived-by-rule: computed by an explicit, auditable lookup/rule (references/*), reproducible

fields.name: stack_tier
fields.notes: Position in the LMCC policy stack (per the landscape map). The rollup that determines a document's shape and how it applies (national=all, regional PARCC=its region, communal PACCC=its commune). Lopsided by design: national/sectoral deep and complete, PACCC thin — that lopsidedness is the finding.

fields.name: source_level
fields.notes: Territorial scale; drives applicability under the LMCC cascade.

fields.name: strand
fields.notes: Sectoral plans carry their family (mitigation/adaptation); frameworks/PARCC/PACCC are cross-cutting; territorial classes are na. Several Chilean sector plans are a single combined mitig+adapt decree — split into two rows here and flagged in notes to avoid double-counting the physical document.

fields.name: sector
fields.notes: For sectoral plans, the sector verbatim; for territorial/PRAS, the domain; null for NDC/LMCC/ECLP/PARCC/PACCC.

fields.name: title_es
fields.notes: Official Spanish title (accents dropped for CSV-safety).

fields.name: publisher
fields.notes: Issuing body (MMA, line ministry, Gobierno Regional/CORECC, municipality).

fields.name: region_code
fields.notes: 2-digit Chile CUT region code; '00' national scope.

fields.name: region_name
fields.notes: Region name via references/cl-region-codes.csv (keyed by region_code).

fields.name: territory_code
fields.notes: level_region_commune: 1_00_00 national; 2_RR_00 regional; 3_RR_000 communal (commune segment 000 pending an INE commune-code lookup). Built from source_level + region_code.

fields.name: law_ref
fields.notes: Enabling law/decree where the instrument is a legal act (Ley 21.455; DS NN/2024 for sector plans; resolution for PARCC/PACCC); null otherwise.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: in-force = vigente/aprobado; draft = anteproyecto/en elaboracion; superseded = replaced by a newer version; uncertain = existence/status not fully confirmed.

fields.name: verified
fields.notes: true = a primary source URL was fetched/confirmed in this pass.

promotion_path: compile -> dataset-review (fetch remaining sector-plan PDFs, track all 16 PARCC approvals, resolve the PACCC sample to per-commune rows, complete provenance) -> catalog + pipeline -> the coverage/applicability layer that turns this inventory into a per-city policy environment via the LMCC cascade.
